title: Palak Paneer Tawa Quesadillas
tagline: Crisp atta flatbreads stuffed with spiced spinach and melty paneer, with a quick tomato salsa for dipping.

ingredients.name: Wheat flour
ingredients.prep: kneaded into a soft dough with water and a pinch of salt

substitutes.name: Leftover rotis
substitutes.note: Use 4 rotis and skip the rolling step.

substitutes.name: Bread
substitutes.note: Make it a grilled sandwich with 4 slices instead.

ingredients.name: Onion
ingredients.prep: half finely chopped, half diced for the salsa

substitutes.name: Butter
substitutes.note: Brush the outside with butter for richness instead.

steps.text: Knead the atta with water and a pinch of salt into a soft dough. Cover and rest for 10 minutes.
Make the salsa: mix the diced tomato, diced onion, coriander, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
steps.tip: Make it first so the flavours mingle while you cook.

steps.text: Heat 1 tsp oil, sauté the chopped onion for 2 minutes, add the spinach and cook until dry, about 3 minutes. Season with chilli powder and salt, then cool slightly.
Mix the spinach with the grated paneer, cheese and chaat masala.
Roll the dough into 4 thin rounds. Spread filling over one half of each, fold into a half-moon and press the edges.
Cook on a hot tawa with a little oil, 2 minutes per side, until golden spots appear and the cheese melts.
steps.tip: Press down with a spatula for an even crisp.

steps.text: Cut into wedges and serve with the salsa.

missing_summary: Add atta (or a few leftover rotis) and you can make Palak Paneer Tawa Quesadillas.
tips: Leftover rotis turn this into a 10-minute snack.
Swap the salsa for green chutney if you have some.
